question: What benefit is obtained through this rite and in which domains does it manifest?
premises: Fortune extends to bathing, drinking, and food.
No doubt remains about this result.
inference: The rite yields great and certain good fortune in daily sustenance and purification.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of snānapānānna to the rest of the verse is compressed.
plain_english: One obtains great good fortune in bathing, drinking, and food; there is no doubt.
